te: A Spanish-Imperial army defeats French-Venetian army in the battle of Bicocca. The battle marks the end of dominance of…
dz: 一支西班牙-帝国军队在比科卡战役中击败了法军-威尼斯军队. 这场战役标志着瑞士雇佣兵在战场上统治的结束,也是火器起决定性作用的先行战役之一.
de: A Spanish-Imperial army defeats French-Venetian army in the battle of Bicocca. The battle marks the end of dominance of Swiss mercenaries on the battlefield and is one of the first where firearms play a decisive role.

t: 奥斯曼人开始第二次围攻罗得斯.
te: Ottomans begin the second Siege of Rhodes.
dz: 奥斯曼人开始第二次围攻罗得斯.
de: Ottomans begin the second Siege of Rhodes.

t: 维多利亚号返回了西班牙的桑卢卡尔·德·巴拉梅达(Sanlúcar de Barrameda),…
te: The Victoria returns to Sanlúcar de Barrameda in Spain, the only surviving ship of Ferdinand Magellan's expedition and …
dz: 维多利亚号返回了西班牙的桑卢卡尔·德·巴拉梅达(Sanlúcar de Barrameda),这是费迪南德·麦哲伦远征军中唯一幸存的一艘船,也是已知最早环绕世界的船只.
de: The Victoria returns to Sanlúcar de Barrameda in Spain, the only surviving ship of Ferdinand Magellan's expedition and the first known ship to circumnavigate the world.

t: 维多利亚抵达塞维利亚,完成第一次环形航行.
te: Victoria arrives at Seville, completing the first circumnavigation.
dz: 麦哲伦-埃尔卡诺环形航行:维多利亚抵达塞维利亚,完成第一次环形航行.
de: Magellan–Elcano circumnavigation: Victoria arrives at Seville, completing the first circumnavigation.
